body.name: fixed arithmetic-mean closed e-test
body.construction: At horizon \(n\), set \(\delta_j^{\mathrm e}=1\), compute \(E_{j,n}=\exp(X_{j,n}-Q_{j,n}/2)\), compute \(E_{I,n}=|I|^{-1}\sum_{j\in I}E_{j,n}\) for every \(I\in\mathcal I\), and reject elementary null \(j\) exactly when \(a_{j,n}=\min_{I\ni j}(E_{I,n}-20)\geq0\).
